title: Brakes and Antiskid — Limitations

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Flight crew limitations for brakes and antiskid, covering brake temperature before take-off, the wear indication the crew may be told about and the taxi practices that consume brake life.

sections.purpose: This entry gives the flight crew limitations that apply to the brakes and the antiskid system, and the operating practices that follow from them.
sections.description: Two limitations govern brake operation from the flight deck. The first is brake temperature before take-off: the aircraft may not begin a take-off roll with any brake above the temperature shown on the wheel page, because the energy of a rejected take-off from that condition is beyond what the stack can absorb. The second is the minimum number of serviceable brakes and the associated antiskid configuration, which is given in the minimum equipment list rather than here. Brake wear is not a flight crew limitation and no wear indication is presented on the flight deck; it appears here only because the crew's taxi technique is what consumes it. On carbon brakes, a large number of light applications wears the stack faster than a small number of firm ones, which is the opposite of the steel brake habit that many crews learned first. Continuous light braking during a long taxi is the single largest avoidable contributor to brake replacement on this aircraft.
sections.crew_procedure: Check the brake temperature on the wheel page before take-off and delay the roll if any brake is above the limit. On taxi, allow the aircraft to accelerate and then brake firmly to the target speed rather than riding the brakes. Use idle thrust and let the aircraft slow naturally where the taxiway allows. After a heavy landing or a rejected take-off, observe the cooling schedule before the next departure and do not select the parking brake if the temperature is above the figure on the page.
sections.limitation_note: Take-off is not permitted with any brake temperature above the value indicated on the wheel page. The brake cooling schedule following a rejected take-off or a heavy landing is mandatory and is given in the performance section. Parking brake selection above the indicated temperature limit is not permitted.

type_data.crew_action: Check brake temperature before take-off; brake firmly and intermittently rather than continuously on taxi.
